title: Release
description: Conformity assessment or certification - CE marking under MDR, FDA clearance, ISO 13485 certification. This is a claim, not a confirmation - whether the issuer is who they claim to be, and how far their accreditation reaches, is answered by their entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema (spec Sec.7).

certified.description: false is representable and meaningful: a declined or withdrawn certification is itself a statement worth logging.

standard.description: The basis for the decision, e.g. "mdr-conformity-assessment", "fda-510k", "iso-13485".

reference.description: A reference number for the certification record, held off-chain.
